entries: When you drink this potion, it removes any {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} levels you have and ends the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition on you. For the next 24 hours, you regain the maximum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} for any {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52|Hit Point Die} you spend.
This potion's crimson liquid regularly pulses with dull light, calling to mind a heartbeat.
